We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for CH3 (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR to see CH3 carbon signals (~10-30 ppm). We need to count distinct methyl groups.

We need to run proton_nmr_spectra tool (expensive but okay). Then analyze peaks: look for signals around 0.9 ppm (alkyl CH3) maybe triplet if adjacent to CH2, etc. Also maybe singlet for tert-butyl etc.

We could also get carbon NMR to confirm number of methyl carbons.

Let's first get proton NMR.
